name: Yatharth Hospital & Trauma Care Services Limited
summary: Yatharth Hospital & Trauma Care Services Limited, established in 2008 and based in Noida, India, runs super-specialty hospitals in Delhi and Madhya Pradesh. Its medical services include women's health, gastroenterology, pulmonology, pediatrics, nephrology and urology, cardiology, orthopedics, spine care and neurosciences, as well as general medicine and surgery.
